RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for MRI brain w/o contrast on August 27, 2026

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your MRI claim. I apologize for any inconvenience this has caused. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file", which means that we did not receive the necessary authorization from your doctor before the service was rendered.

You have the right to appeal this decision. You may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. To do so, your ordering provider (Dr. L. Okonjo) may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity. 

The 180-day appeal window for your claim started on the date of the denial notice. I have calculated the exact deadline date for you, which is February 1, 2027. Please note that standard appeals are decided within 30 calendar days.

I am attaching the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this response for your reference. If you have any questions or need further assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan Member Services
